slides.title: Where Markets Start
slides.body: The S&P 500 closed Nov 20 at 6,910.39, down 8.6% on the week and 11.6% below its Oct 6 record. The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.91%.

slides.title: The Big Data Day: Wed, Nov 25
slides.body: The government's second look at Q3 growth lands at 8:30 a.m. ET, with October income and spending. The first estimate was 3.4%. The Fed Beige Book follows at 2 p.m.

slides.title: Why It Matters
slides.body: The Fed meets Dec 8-9, and officials are debating more rate hikes. This week's data and the Dec 4 jobs report feed that call. Thin holiday trading can exaggerate moves.
